decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the new $5 founder share, $5 prize-pool share, and Small Block as the active prize pool.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block messaging and updates the FAQ with the $5/$5/$5 allocation and remaining Small Block prizes.
The existing same-message MODIFY already narrows the no-code ticket award from Small and Big Block tickets to a Small Block ticket.
Eliminating Big Blocks does not change the existing Small Block winner count, $500 prize amount, eligible population, or 100-sale draw trigger.
The existing same-message MODIFY already narrows eligible winners to Small Block ticket holders; the source does not change randomness, weighting, or verification rules.
The existing same-message MODIFY already retains only the Small Block counter, records Big Block ticket removal, removes obsolete Big Block lifecycle keys, and narrows scope.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes each successful referral's ticket award to one Small Block ticket while preserving the $5 commission.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter metadata key.
Removing Big Blocks does not change the automatic prize-transfer workflow or the existing winner announcement and notification channels.
The revenue-allocation and Big Block decision does not change which NFT asset a primary mint must deliver.
The fixed $15 mint allocation does not modify or remove the independently optional tipping feature.
Eliminating Big Blocks and changing revenue allocation does not affect use of the NFT mint number as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
